{{Quote|Duro. They're going to hit the shipyards in thirty-six standard hours.|Jace Malcom|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
The '''Battle of Duro''' occurred above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] in [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Having laid a trap for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Karrid]] and her prototype warship ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'', [[Supreme Commander (disambiguation)|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] destroyed the fleet of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nezzor]] before it could attack Duro, and the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] were able to distract and kill Karrid aboard the ''Spear'' so that the ship could be destroyed.
